schema_note: Provisional FUNUJE interface intelligence. NOT a runtime token set. No value here may be consumed by product code until the conflicts in `conflicts` are resolved by a human decision.

truth_state.removal_reason: DECLARED conflated provenance with evidential status. Operator declaration is an origin, not a truth state.

source_origin.note: Independent of truth_state. Records where a claim came from.

S2.name: funuje Brand Kit v1.0 (May 2024), 8 panels
S2.caveat: hex values transcribed from printed labels; not pixel-sampled

S9.name: Mr. Lexx / Diggy Nation vault site

color._status: CONTESTED - two incompatible palettes share the same role names. See conflicts.A

graphite_glass.source_evidence: S1 s5 + usage table 'app UI: graphite cards on obsidian'

signal_red.role: energy, CTA, active state, glow, audio pulse

warm_cream.role: primary text on dark; display type on red fields

soft_gold.source_evidence: S1 s5 + usage table 'premium: black + gold + cream'

cyan_signal.role: analytics, data, active streaming indicators, dashboard highlights
cyan_signal.source_evidence: S1 s5 verbatim; resolves the Pass-1 UNRESOLVED on this token

deep_wine.role: depth ground only; never text or UI (1.45:1 on obsidian)

brand_kit_v1_0._note: Recorded for reconciliation. NOT recommended. Lacks gold and cyan, which the verified producer and premium systems depend on; and admits no AA-compliant text colour on its red button.

graphite_on_obsidian.implication: panel separation cannot rely on fill alone

white_on_red.implication: no AA-normal-compliant label exists for a red primary button in this palette

derived_rule.basis: S1 s9 permits 'cream or white' on the primary CTA; measurement selects between them
derived_rule.rule: cream on red only at >=24px or >=18.66px bold; white on red at all smaller sizes

display.note: S1 describes display personality (bold, wide, rounded, geometric, heavyweight, rhythmic, festival-poster, retro-broadcast) but NAMES NO FACE. Anton is sourced solely from S2.
display.open_issue: Anton ships a single weight and no italic; the lowercase wordmark is custom, not set in Anton. Wordmark and display face must be treated as separate assets.

body_ui.conflict: S1 s6 lists seven and OMITS Satoshi; S2 names Satoshi as the single body/UI face
body_ui.preferred_interpretation: select from the S1 seven; Space Grotesk or General Sans are closest in character to Satoshi

scale.note: no sizes, weights, line-heights or tracking in any source

adoption_reality.finding: S6 sitemap, S7 flow and S2 panel 06 all use generic naming (Home, Discover, Release, Studio, Community, Library, Search, Profile). Only S9 uses a zone name (VAULT).
adoption_reality.disposition: conflicts.B - zone naming preferred for product surface; generic terms retained as routing/analytics keys only

signal_namespace_collision.requirement: unqualified token name `signal` must be prohibited in code; every reference must carry its namespace

card.description: rounded black-glass card with subtle red glow and soft shadows

stroke.source_evidence: faint light edges visible in S2 panels 05/06/08 and S9
stroke.note: Pass-1 claimed stroke was the PRIMARY elevation signal. REJECTED: S1 specifies glow + shadow and never mentions a stroke. The 1.14:1 measurement proves separation is needed; the source states what provides it.

cta_primary.label: cream or white
cta_primary.source_evidence: S1 s9; S2 panel 04 'PLAY NOW' uses white

cta_quiet.note: no tertiary/ghost variant defined in any source

zone_shell.disposition: REJECTED as source-grounded. No source describes persistent chrome; S2 panel 06 shows a conventional 4-item bottom tab bar.

persistent_player.disposition: REJECTED as source-grounded. S2 panel 06 shows a full-screen Now Playing view and no mini-player on Home.

glow_model.revision_note: Pass-1 claimed glow is state-only, never ambient. REVISED: S1 supports two tiers.

tier_ambient.description: subtle red glow as a default property of black-glass cards

tier_active.description: intensified red glow denoting active state
tier_active.source_evidence: S1 usage table 'artist profiles: black-glass UI + red active glow'

motifs.red_field: loudest expression of the brand; full-bleed identity moment

signal_bar.function: loading bar, status indicator, audio pulse, campaign marker

motifs.frequency_ring: profile images, verified artists, live sessions, premium releases
motifs.red_dot: live recording, new drops, active campaigns, exclusive content

tempo_anchoring.note: 'musical timing' implies BPM-derived durations; no tempo is stated

prefers_reduced_motion.note: the entire motion language is pulse/scan/glow; no fallback is defined in any source

B.subject: zone vocabulary vs generic IA in product artifacts
B.preferred: zones for product surface; generic as routing keys only

E.subject: Caribbean cultural OS vs generic streaming clone

F.subject: access tiers - S1 five layers vs S2 three tiers

G.subject: wordmark defects - S8 renders 'funuju'; S6 drops the macron

basis: S7 renders Studio as the glowing hub node of the user's own flow diagram
most completely and consistently specified area across S1 s13, S1 s14 and the S6 Studio branch

first_surface_recommendation.counter_argument: The Console proves mechanics, not soul. If Pass 2 needs a persuasive brand artifact rather than durable primitives, The Booth is the better choice - S9 shows it half-built and on-brand, and S1 s13 fully specifies its content model.
